issues.text: New in changed text. Section 4 and q1's explanation say the Dockerfile adds exactly one OS package, while q7's explanation says 'the few the Dockerfile installs' and claim 7 says 'libgssapi-krb5-2 and its libraries'. Dockerfile line 52 names one package, but apt-get also installs its dependencies; the SBOM lists libkrb5-3, libk5crypto3, libkrb5support0 from the same krb5 source next to it. 'The one' is narrower than the ledger and inconsistent with q7.
issues.quote: OS packages (the base image's, plus the one the Dockerfile installs)
issues.fix: Section 4: 'OS packages (the base image's, plus the one the Dockerfile installs with apt-get and the libraries it needs)'. q1 explanation correct (en/vi): replace 'the one package the Dockerfile installs' with 'the package the Dockerfile installs with apt-get, with the libraries it needs'.

issues.quote: "`Directory.Packages.props` and `pubspec.lock` together already are the SBOM of the api image."
issues.text: Carried from round 1. I would never think a Flutter app's lock file describes the api image, so half of this belief is not one I would hold. The believable half is 'the project files are the SBOM'. (The writer kept it because q7 d depends on it; still minor.)
issues.fix: Make the belief 'Directory.Packages.props, or DonHang.Api/packages.lock.json, already is the SBOM of the api image' and drop the pubspec.lock sentence; rewrite q7 d's misconception to match.

issues.quote: Đơn Hàng writes SBOMs as CycloneDX JSON, a published format other tools can read without the image.
issues.text: Carried from round 1, narrowed. Section 3-4 now say 'standard format' and 'a flaw is made public', but summary line 4 still says 'a published format' and section 6 'published flaws', next to 'the published app' and the publish job. I still stop to decide which 'publish' is meant.
issues.fix: In summary line 4 replace 'a published format' with 'a standard format', matching Core concepts and section 4.

issues.quote: It was installed into the image's operating system, not restored by a .NET project.
issues.text: New in changed text. q1's reworded option a now repeats the new Core concepts gloss of OS package ('installed into the image's operating system, outside any .NET project'), so I can match words without understanding what pkg:deb means.
issues.fix: Rephrase option a around where the component came from, e.g. 'It came with the base image or the Dockerfile's install step, not from any project file.'

issues.quote: even leaving out the few the Dockerfile installs, the base image brings most of the list
issues.text: New in changed text. Section 4 says 'plus the one the Dockerfile installs' and q1's explanation 'the one package the Dockerfile installs', but q7's explanation says 'the few'. I cannot tell whether the Dockerfile adds one OS package or several.
